content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Owns and charters ocean gas carriers for commodity cargo under time and voyage charters, the same ship-owning freight model, though the cargo is LPG."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Owns and charters dry bulk vessels carrying coal, iron ore and grain under time and voyage charters, matching the target's core business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Provides truckload, intermodal and brokerage land transport in North America, with no ocean shipping or vessel ownership."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Provides engineering, consulting and construction services for government and infrastructure clients, not freight transport."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells guided leisure expedition cruises and tours to individual travelers, not commercial cargo shipping."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Builds and maintains telecom, utility and pipeline infrastructure under construction contracts, not transport services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Provides less-than-truckload road freight across North America, a land trucking business with no vessels."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Runs auctions and online marketplaces for used equipment, earning sale commissions rather than moving cargo."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Performs on-site inspection, repair and heat treating for refineries and plants, a field maintenance service business."}]}
